annotations.title: Build a CPSC certificate data sheet per SKU from the lab test report, checked against 16 CFR 1110.11 and the eCFR, with a signed record

description: CPSC certificate data sheet from the lab test report: one sheet per SKU with every data element 16 CFR 1110.11(a)(1)-(6) asks a finished product certificate (CPC or GCC) to carry, in the rule's order, for the customs broker who eFiles it in ACE. Send what you read off the test report and the importer's records: product identifiers and description, each rule cited with the lab(s) that tested it and the test date (or the testing exclusion claimed), the certifier, the records keeper, date and place of manufacture, and each lab. Get back, per SKU, each element marked ok, missing or check, a plain-text sheet, and whether each cited 16 CFR part exists in the eCFR and when it was last amended (eCFR version history, cached up to 24 hours, read time stated). Free. No model, nothing stored, signed record. Up to 25 SKUs and 60,000 bytes per call. Plain ASCII text only (this tool's limit). Not legal advice: it does not file, does not decide which rules apply, and does not check a lab against CPSC's accepted-lab list.

certificates.description: One certificate per SKU (16 CFR 1110.13(a): each certificate describes only one product).

certifier.description: The importer (or domestic manufacturer or private labeler) certifying.

state_province.description: Required; send "none" where the place has no state or province.

cpsc_lab_id.description: CPSC lab ID of an accepted third party lab (expected for a CPC).

key.description: Your short key for this lab, used in rules[].tested_by.

state_province.description: Required; send "none" where the place has no state or province.

tested_on.description: Most recent test date at this lab, YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYY-MM); a rule's own tested_on wins.

date.description: YYYY-MM (first day of the run, month and year at a minimum).

place.description: The manufacturer: name and address, email, phone.

state_province.description: Required; send "none" where the place has no state or province.

product.description: At least one identifier (sku, gtin, upc, model, serial, registered_number, alternate_id) and a description that matches the product to the certificate. lot, style, color optional.

records_keeper.description: The person (or always-staffed position title) keeping the test records.

state_province.description: Required; send "none" where the place has no state or province.

records_url.description: Optional https link to the supporting records (1110.11(b)). Shown on the sheet, never fetched.

citation.description: A CPSC rule, e.g. '16 CFR 1250' or '16 CFR 1303.1', or a statute, e.g. 'CPSIA 101(a)' or '15 USC 1278a'.

exclusion.description: The statutory or regulatory testing exclusion claimed for this rule, instead of a test (1110.11(c)).

tested_by.description: key(s) of the lab(s) in labs whose testing this rule depends on.

tested_on.description: Most recent test date for this rule, YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYY-MM). If left out, the lab's tested_on is used.

type.description: CPC = Children's Product Certificate; GCC = General Certificate of Conformity.
